candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, and the blood of the righteous from the earth before the Lord of Spirits' — the prayer-of-the-righteous-ascending pattern. Tewahedo intercession theology (the role of saints and martyrs as ongoing intercessors) takes this verse as scriptural foundation for the belief that the martyrs' blood actively cries out before God (parallel to Rev 6:9-10, which draws on this Enochic image).

candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, and the books of the living were opened before Him: and all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him' — books-of-the-living courtroom scene. The textual genealogy from this image to Dan 7:9-10 to Rev 20:12 forms a continuous Tewahedo eschatological tradition; the books-of-the-living trope appears in the Anaphora of the Three Hundred Eighteen Orthodox.
